# The five-beat tear-out pins a popup bootstrap without the shell flag

## Context

`test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs:1843` fails on `dev` since #20623 merged (`4054658877`). On `dev` at `7214b9249e`, `E2E (engine tier)` is red on `e2e-engine (3/14)`, job 128897787827. The same assertion reds that shard on #20630 and #20631.

```
Error: expect(received).toEqual(expected) // deep equality
+   "shell": false,
    at test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs:1843:38
```

## The Problem

Scene 2 (the tear-out that births a vessel mid-gesture) checks that the popup is born with the carried theme, and pins the popup's whole `globalThis.WorkstationBootstrap` with `toEqual`. #20623 added `shell` to that object, so the pin no longer matches on any engine-tier e2e run. No other spec pins the object.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/workstation/index.html` freezes `WorkstationBootstrap` with `colorScheme`, `defaultTheme`, `schemes` and `theme`, and since #20623 also `shell: Boolean(globalThis.neoShell) || /\bElectron\//i.test(globalThis.navigator?.userAgent ?? '')`.
- `Workstation.view.VesselWorkspace` reads `bootstrap?.shell` to decide whether a refused `windowOpen` gets browser popup-setting guidance (#20623).
- A popup born in a browser, as in CI, reports `shell: false`.
- Design authority: n/a — the spec's expectation is stale; the bootstrap behaves as #20623 intends.

## The Fix

Add `shell: false` to the expected object at `WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs:1843`. The pin stays exact, and it now also witnesses that a browser-born popup reports no shell, the input #20623's guidance reads.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Scene 2's bootstrap pin includes `shell: false`.
- [ ] The scene 2 tear-out test fails on `dev` with the `"shell": false` diff and passes at head.
- [ ] `e2e-engine (3/14)` is green on the PR's head.

## Out of Scope

- Loosening the pin, for example to `toMatchObject`: the exact object is the scene's contract.
- `Pointer.spec.mjs:630` flaking in the same `dev` push's `Engine Tests` run: separate, sent to its owner.
